precepts.text: Seeing we have this ministry, we faint not; but have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty. When you seek his face openly, you renounce the secret sins: not walking in craftiness, not talking your way around it, nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience. Blessed is the man whose conscience does not condemn him, because he examined himself against the word and renounced what he was doing. But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost: if you do not understand that you have to renounce sin, you are lost. That is the Christian church: we are not under the law, we are under grace, you cannot call me a sinner, I am saved; yet the hidden things have never been renounced. Your religion is vain if the secret life never changes.
precepts.point: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory. When we behold the glass openly, we change. There is supposed to be a change in us.

note.label: Listen, Learn & Live The Art of Enduring in The Truth

precepts.why:
Beholding with open face, we are changed. Then chapter 4: “Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not; But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty”. That is what we are supposed to do when we seek him openly, face to face: renounce the hidden things, the secret sins.

“not walking in craftiness”: not talking too much, trying to find a way to snake around it, “nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.” Blessed is the man whose conscience does not condemn him, because he has examined himself against this book, renounced what he was doing, and no longer does it.

“But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost”. If you do not understand that you have to behold with an open face and renounce sin, you are lost. That is the Christian church: we are no longer under the laws of God, we are under grace, you can't call me a sinner, I've been saved. Bro, what are you talking about? You have not renounced the hidden things of dishonesty. You're an undercover homo. You're still fornicating, still smoking weed, effeminate, popping gum with your sister's lip gloss on. You have not renounced it, so you are lost.

If you think you found God while the secret life never changes, your religion is vain. It is a level of insanity to ask God to deal with you and then not do what God says. The change from glory to glory comes only when the hidden things are renounced.

precepts.text: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life, that he may please him who chose him to be a soldier. Christ chose us; when Ezekiel saw the exceeding great army he saw purple and gold, because who else is going nation to nation and island to island teaching?
precepts.point: We look not at the things which are seen, which are temporal, but at the things not seen, which are eternal. America influences the whole world in music and culture, but this power will fall; the kingdom we cannot see yet lasts forever. Stack your bricks and do not be a situational Israelite.
precepts.why:
“for the things which are seen are temporal”: the things we see now are temporary. They are not going to last forever, so there is no need for us to get caught up in the things of the world. The United States of America is the world superpower and influences the whole world. Whatever music is played in America, whatever is in pop culture, the whole world responds to it. But this regime, this power, will fall, thus saith the Lord. Now we have to put our focus on overcoming the beast.

“No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life”. Anybody in this war against evil does not entangle himself with the affairs of this life, “that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.” Who chose us? Our Lord and Saviour, Jesus the Christ. He chose us to be soldiers in his military.

When Ezekiel saw that exceeding great army, he saw purple and gold. Who else is out there as foot soldiers, going nation to nation, island to island, land to land, teaching the word of God? It is not to boast; it is just the reality.

So a soldier keeps his eyes on what is not seen. We do not see the kingdom right now, but the Lord lets us know it will last forever. The Lord is doing his job; it is time for us to do ours.

precepts.text: Be not conformed to this world but transformed by the renewing of your mind. New creatures in Christ; if you feel Satan raising his head and the old man coming back, do everything to deaden that spirit.
precepts.point: We look not at the things which are seen, which are temporal, but at the things not seen, which are eternal. America influences the whole world in music and culture, but this power will fall; the kingdom we cannot see yet lasts forever. Stack your bricks and do not be a situational Israelite.
precepts.why:
“the things which are not seen are eternal” We do not see the kingdom yet, but it will last forever. So we have to stack our bricks, and we cannot be situational Israelites. We have to be in the spirit and move in the spirit, knowing our eternal home awaits us. It is a spiritual battle, a spiritual war.

“And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind”. We have to change by the renewing of our minds, because we are now new creatures in Christ. The mindset has to change.

Those things that used to trip us up so often and so easily in the world, in this day and age, cannot keep doing it. If you feel Satan raising up his head against you, if you feel that old man coming back, you have to do any and everything to deaden that spirit. Now ain't the time for that.

That is what it means to look not at the things which are seen. The world presses its pop culture and pleasures on us, but a mind renewed stays fixed on the eternal kingdom rather than conforming to a power that is about to fall.

precepts.text: Lay aside every weight and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and run with patience the race. Wisdom of Solomon 9:15: the corruptible body presseth down the soul. Some things stop when you come in, pork, Sabbath-breaking, the beard, but lust, hatred, and covetousness do not go away; you learn to keep that Negro or Latino in check until you die or Christ returns. Do not worry about the war in Iran; God has that. Worry about the day-to-day war.
precepts.point: We look not at the things which are seen, which are temporal, but at the things not seen, which are eternal. America influences the whole world in music and culture, but this power will fall; the kingdom we cannot see yet lasts forever. Stack your bricks and do not be a situational Israelite.
precepts.why:
“Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight”: everything that is trying to keep us from serving our God. That is exactly what sin does. “For the corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind that museth upon many things.” The earthly tabernacle is our flesh. We were born and shapen in iniquity, so understand the condition of the battle: we will fight against our flesh until we die or until Christ returns.

A lot of people think that when they come into the truth, things will just go away. Some things you stop doing: eating pork, breaking the Lord's Sabbath, not wearing fringes, shaving your beard. You start keeping the commandments, your reasonable service. But hatred, lust and covetousness do not go away. You learn how to cope with them, and you have to prove yourself to the Lord that you are able to keep that Negro in check, that Latino in check.

“and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us”. We do not have a lot of time left. Now is high time to wake up out of sleep and fight this battle right here. We are not worried about the war in Iran; God already has that. We need to worry about the war on the day-to-day.

That is looking at the things which are not seen: running the race with patience toward the eternal, not weighed down by the temporal.

precepts.text: They that use this world as not abusing it, for the fashion of this world passeth away. Use the things of the world without leaning on them over Christ; the fear should kick in on its own, so nobody has to keep checking you. Sirach 1:19, wisdom raineth down skill; walking with Christ should make you skilful in the word by default.
precepts.point: We look not at the things which are seen, which are temporal, but at the things not seen, which are eternal. America influences the whole world in music and culture, but this power will fall; the kingdom we cannot see yet lasts forever. Stack your bricks and do not be a situational Israelite.
precepts.why:
This kingdom will go down. It will pass away just like everything else. “And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passeth away.” You can use the things of this world, but do not get caught up. Do not hit the snooze button, do not abuse it, and do not lean on the things of this world over Christ.

If we really believe this Bible, we know the things of this world are going to pass away, and that fear should kick in on its own. Someone should not always have to check you. You read the Bible just like the next man. We understand young spirits, but eventually, as you walk, you check yourself.

You should become skilful in the word of God. “Wisdom raineth down skill and knowledge of understanding standing, and exalteth them to honour that hold her fast.” If wisdom is walking with you, if Christ is in you, by default you become skilful in the word and in how to apply wisdom in certain situations. You embody Christ, and everybody can see wisdom walking with you.

So the things seen are temporal and the fashion of this world passes away, while the things not seen are eternal. Use the world lightly and hold fast to wisdom.

precepts.text: Whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders, and all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish, because they received not the love of the truth. God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie: that the white man is the Jew and Christian, that pork is clean, that Christ died for all nations. Delusion is a false belief held despite evidence; the Lord allows America's evil in order to break his people out of it.
precepts.point: If our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost, in whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not. The god of this world is Satan working through the white man, who blinds minds with his great mouth, speaking lies and blasphemy through every screen.

note.label: Cyber Warfare: The Mouth Of The Beast

precepts.why:
“But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost”. If you do not understand that Christ is a black man, that the children of the transatlantic slave trade are the Jews according to the Bible, and that Christ is coming to bring vengeance on all nations that oppress us, it is because you are lost. “In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not”. Some say the god of this world is the spiritual demon Satan, but always start with his physical counterpart: the so-called white man, who creates these technologies and deceives the world physically. He blinds your mind with his mouth, that great mouth speaking lies and blasphemy.

Thessalonians shows how: “Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”. That is America, coming into power after the working of the spiritual demon Satan, “with all power and signs and lying wonders”: the technology, the media, social media. “And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.” You did not love this truth. You loved the white man and his lies, and you hate yourself.

“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie”. A delusion is a false belief or judgment about external reality, held despite incontrovertible evidence to the contrary. We show our people the evidence and it does not matter. The lies are that the white man is the Jew, when Christ called them the synagogue of Satan; that white people are the Christians, when the Christians were the Israelites that converted and followed Christ; that you can eat pork and shrimp; that Christ came and died for all nations. Christianity is under that delusion, and so are those who believe the people in the land of Israel are the Jews. They cannot come out unless God opens their eyes.

So God allows America to do crazy stuff on this earth, and uses it to wake his people up and break the spell of that strong delusion. “That they all might be damned who believed not the truth”: everyone that does not believe this truth will be damned, with no repentance. You can curse us and call us names; it is what it is.

precepts.text: False Christs and false prophets shall shew great signs and wonders, insomuch that if it were possible they shall deceive the very elect. Captain America, the Avengers and GI Joe trained our minds, but it is not possible to deceive the elect.
precepts.point: If our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost, in whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not. The god of this world is Satan working through the white man, who blinds minds with his great mouth, speaking lies and blasphemy through every screen.

note.label: Cyber Warfare: The Mouth Of The Beast

precepts.why:
“For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets”. That is Christianity, what you see here today: the image of the beast, the white man coming and speaking lies in Christ's name. That is the god of this world blinding the minds of them which believe not.

“and shall shew great signs and wonders”: his technology. That is his mouth, the television, the Hollywood movies. Growing up we watched Captain America and GI Joe, the American heroes, and now the Avengers. All of it puts white people forward as what they are not. Those things were brainwashing us and messing with our minds.

“insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.” Is it possible for them to deceive the elect? No. The illusion and delusion is so strong that if it were possible, even the elect would have been taken. But it is not possible. That is why we are waking up today and see clearly. They cannot trick us or fool us; we are not under that delusion, though the whole world is.

This is the mouth of the dragon: social media and technology, used to monitor, control and deceive the people and put propaganda out there. Netanyahu and the Israeli government want to control social media to stop the truth from going forth, as they took down our pages before, and soon we will not be teaching on YouTube at all. But the elect cannot be deceived by that mouth, and God will make their own tongue fall upon themselves.
